newsitem.title: UK: Vardon says Q1 trading positive.
newsitem.headline: Vardon says Q1 trading positive.

text.p: Leisure group Vardon Plc said on Thursday that trading in the first three months of the year has followed the positive trend seen in the in the last quarter of 1996.
Chairman David Hudd speaking at the company's annual general meeting said that Vardon's health and fitness division has started the year well with 10 million of investment planned in 1997.
He said that the company's Bingo division was peforming well with total revenue up nine percent on 1996 and like for like revenues up two percent.
Bookings at Vardon's Holdiays division are up six percent by value on 1996 with sales at a "satisfactory level".
